description: What holding ratios did large shareholding reports and change reports about this Japanese issuer state? Newest first, per report: each holder's ratio and the ratio stated for its previous report, shares held and outstanding, base date, obligation and filing dates, amended document, and the joint total when stated. Read from EDINET's CSV of each report. Names only for corporate holders; others withheld. Facts as filed: not evaluated, nothing about purposes or intentions.

holder.description: Optional EDINET code of a holder (E12345): only reports that list this holder

issuer.description: Issuer: EDINET code (e.g. E02144), securities code (4 or 5 characters, e.g. 7203 or 72030) or 13-digit corporate number

since.description: Only reports submitted on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: start of the indexed range

name: edinet_large_holding_reports

coverage.description: What this service has indexed: the date range, missing days (backfill in progress) and freshness.

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

reports.description: Newest first; figures as filed, not evaluated.

contents.description: read; not_yet_read (in the index, contents not fetched yet); no_csv; not_found; unreadable; withdrawn.

name_ja.description: Only for holders filed as corporations (法人).

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.
